name: StackTeamLunchTemplate
description: Top-level Claude Design template for Stack, a mobile-first office team lunch group-ordering product.
accessibility: The production implementation should use semantic navigation, buttons, links, forms, and status updates for each screen.
The tracking screen should announce major delivery status changes through an aria-live region.
The item customization screen should group required choices with fieldset and legend semantics.

do: Use as the high-level reference for implementing the Stack browse, menu, item, cart, tracking, orders, and profile flows.
Keep the mobile-first hierarchy: status/header area, scrollable content, and bottom tab or sticky CTA.
Use real food imagery that clearly shows the restaurant or dish.
dont: Do not copy the Claude handoff's inline prototype structure directly into production.
Do not ship the fake phone frame in the production app; reserve it for preview and documentation surfaces.
Do not mix multiple palettes on the same screen.

sourceHandoff.intent: Office team lunch group ordering, mobile-first, clean minimal modern aesthetic, clickable flow across browse/menu/item/cart/tracking/orders/profile, with palette and font tweaks.
